release_notes:
Two small UX tweaks.

1. Volume slider now defaults to the middle (50) instead of 70 on a fresh install. Existing users keep whatever value they had saved -- the change only affects new installs / configs without alert_volume set. Touched three spots: ConfigStore default, the alert_volume_var IntVar initial value, and the data.get fallback in _load_config_into_form. The receiver-side fallback for missing alert_volume in incoming peer payloads is intentionally left at 70 so cross-version playback behavior is unaffected.

2. Outgoing log entries now read 'Sent -> <target>' instead of 'Ready -> <target>'. Only the leading word changes -- the arrow, target name list, timestamp, and emphasis tier logic are unchanged, and the incoming 'Sender: Ready' format is untouched. Today's pre-rename persisted OUT lines are rewritten on next startup via a small migration in _load_ready_log so the log looks consistent immediately after restart rather than waiting for the midnight file rollover.
